b: I believe it’s is pointless to require someone to swear an oath to tell the truth in court. It should simply just be illegal to lie when giving testimony.

I have no religious beliefs, there is no passage of text I could rest my hand on which adds extra weight to the words I am saying. The same with testing my hand over my heart, I don’t understand how that adds any more meaning or makes what I am saying any more believable. The whole system is outdated.
I completely agree that perjury should be a crime, and that it shouldn’t be illegal to lie to your friends etc. I just don’t think swearing an oath does anything to actually achieve this.
